name: threshwork
description: Threshwork — automation portfolio control plane for content operations (OpenAPI-first DDD)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ddd/core build && pnpm --filter @ddd/services build && pnpm --filter @ddd/adapters build && pnpm --filter @ddd/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:queues: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain queues --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:routing: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain routing --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:vendors: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain vendors --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:portfolio: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain portfolio --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:product: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain queues --domain routing --domain vendors --domain portfolio --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:webapp: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --domain queues --domain routing --domain vendors --domain portfolio --layers webapp --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build --no-fail-fast --no-clean && node scripts/rewrite-webapp-clients.mjs
